question: According to the Indian Railways (2019-2020), which state has the largest railway track in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __Uttar Pradesh__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the Indian Railways (2019-2020), Uttar Pradesh has the largest railway track in India. 

 
 
• As of 31.03.2020, the route length of Indian Railways covered 67,956 km with a running track length of 99,235 km.
 
• The total trackage including yards, sidings etc. stood at 1,26,366 km. 
 
• In India, the largest route kilometers are in Uttar Pradesh with 8726 kilometres. This comes out to be 13.6% of India’s total Route Kilometers. The Five states with the largest route kilometres are as follows:
 
• Uttar Pradesh: 8,808.
 
• **Rajasthan: 5,894**
 
• **Maharashtra: 5,784 **
 
• **Karnataka: 3,542 **
 
• **Jharkhand: With 2,596**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The first railway line in India was opened for public traffic on 16 April 1853 between Mumbai and Thane over a distance of 34 km.
 
• Meanwhile, the construction of the railway lines was going on in the eastern part of the country, and the first section of the East Indian Railway, from Howrah to Hugli, a distance of 37 km was inaugurated on 15 August 1854.
